issues.description: Method 'addGuestStudents' in class Lecture: the problem statement (Part 2 task description and the UML) and the solution implementation expect a single-parameter signature addGuestStudents(int): void. The template implementation declares addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) — i.e. an extra boolean parameter. This parameter-list mismatch forces students to either change the provided template signature or implement a different method than described in the task/UML and may cause compilation or grading failures if tests or graders call addGuestStudents(int).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template signature consistent with the problem statement and solution: change the template declaration to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and implement the method body accordingly. If the boolean parameter was intentionally required for input validation, instead update the problem statement/UML and the solution implementation to document and use the boolean parameter consistently (or provide a single-argument overload that matches the exercise description).
